RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the Reach. Reach titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Hedge Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A landless knight whose courage and service have earned recognition from the houses of the Reach.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a house of the Reach, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the Reach.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: A paramount ruler honored above the great houses of the Reach for exceptional service and leadership.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Warden of the South
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Reach's highest honor, recognizing a military guardian of the South and defender of its borders. It grants your House standing without replacing the Reach's Warden or transferring its lands.
